prompt_short: Onboard mysql_retail_erp but that service already exists in OpenMetadata.

assertions.text: Response calls or references user-openmetadata:get_database_service before any onboard apply
assertions.evidence: Opens with get_database_service returned 404 before any plan/apply.

assertions.text: Response does NOT run catalog_onboard_apply.py or create_database_service in this turn
assertions.evidence: Explicitly did not write plan or run apply.

assertions.text: Response either hard-stops because service exists OR reports name mismatch with list_database_services if not found
assertions.evidence: Reports mismatch and tables snowflake_fivetran and test_postgres_retail_erp.

assertions.text: Response points to standard Workflow (run_ingestion_pipeline) instead of onboard create when service exists
assertions.evidence: Option 1 lists run_ingestion_pipeline standard workflow for existing connector.
